CustomField.description: Formula field that calculates the next rent due date based on the start date and payment frequency. Weekly = every 7 days, Fortnightly = every 14 days, Monthly = every 30 days from start date.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Rent_Start_Date__c), NULL, IF( ISPICKVAL(Rent_Frequency__c, "Weekly"), Rent_Start_Date__c + (CEILING(MAX(TODAY() - Rent_Start_Date__c, 0) / 7) * 7), IF( ISPICKVAL(Rent_Frequency__c, "Fortnightly"), Rent_Start_Date__c + (CEILING(MAX(TODAY() - Rent_Start_Date__c, 0) / 14) * 14), Rent_Start_Date__c + (CEILING(MAX(TODAY() - Rent_Start_Date__c, 0) / 30) * 30) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Next Due Date
